verdict.rationale: React's docs explicitly guide developers to scaffold quickly via recommended frameworks (Next.js/React Router) or build tools like Vite/Parcel/Rsbuild, and even offer a no-install sandbox to try React instantly, but React itself no longer ships its own official CLI (create-react-app is not mentioned/is deprecated) — scaffolding is delegated to third-party tooling. missing for 10: no first-party 'create-react-app'-style CLI, no direct quantified 'few minutes' setup benchmark, no independent hands-on confirmation of setup speed.
